title: Kissed Wood Fired Croatian Vegetable Casserole
description: A hearty, flexitarian-friendly Croatian dish featuring wood-fired baked vegetables and basil, perfect for a post-workout meal. This casserole is jammy, aerated, and full of flavor.
instructions: Preheat the wood fired oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sliced eggplant and zucchini with a little bit of oil and season with salt and pepper.
In a large Dutch oven, create a layer of tomato sauce on the bottom.
Add a layer of eggplant and zucchini slices on top of the tomato sauce.
Add a layer of chopped onion and minced garlic on top of the eggplant and zucchini.
Sprinkle a layer of shredded mozzarella cheese on top of the onion and garlic.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of mozzarella cheese on top.
Cover the Dutch oven with a lid and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the casserole from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh basil.
